name: lw_41261
statement: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) : 1 / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + a / Real.sqrt (1 + a ^ 2) + b / Real.sqrt (1 + b ^ 2) > 2
closed: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1), 1 / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + a / Real.sqrt (1 + a ^ 2) + b / Real.sqrt (1 + b ^ 2) > 2
informal: Let $a, b > 0$ and $a+b=1$. Prove that $\frac{1}{\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}} + \frac{a}{\sqrt{1 + a^{2}}} + \frac{b}{\sqrt{1 + b^{2}}} > 2$
